title: [Master] - Chance of success % does not validate correctly when using the action type "Update" in Opportunity
summary: The Chance of Success percentage field in opportunities now validates correctly when using the Update action type. A validation fix and test cases were added to ensure the field accepts only values between 0 and 100.
